result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are minor cosmetic inconsistencies in the UI.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant name is clipped significantly in the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text styling to either wrap or resize the font to avoid hard clipping of the restaurant name.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar has icons that are quite close to the screen edge and the bottom-most graphical element is slightly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or margins for the bottom navigation bar to ensure better visual clearance from the screen boundary.
